paite: Huai nung in Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng Shiloh ah akikhawm ua, huai ah kihoupihna biakbuk akai uhi. Huai gam teng azou khinta uhi.
heading: Gam Om Lai Teng Hawmna
english: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The land was subdued before them.

paite: Israel suante lak ah atantuam uh tang nai lou nam sagih a-om lai uhi.
english: Seven tribes remained among the children of Israel, which had not yet divided their inheritance.

paite: Joshua in Israel suante kiang ah, "TOUPA na pipute uh Pathian in nou hon piaksa gam, bang tan ahia luah lou a na awltat lai ding uh?
english: Joshua said to the children of Israel, “How long will you neglect to go in to possess the land, which Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has given you?

paite: Nam chih a kipan mi thum zel telkhia unla; amau akuan ding ua, gam ava en vialvial ding ua, atantuam hun ding uh bang chiat zel in ava gelh ding ua; ka kiang ah ahong nawn ding uh.
english: Appoint for yourselves three men from each tribe. I will send them, and they shall arise, walk through the land, and describe it according to their inheritance; then they shall come to me.

paite: Mun sagih in akhen phot ding ua; Judah pawl simlam ah atantuam uah a-om ding ua, Joseph inkuante mallam ah atantuam uah a-om ding uh.
english: They shall divide it into seven portions. Judah shall live in his borders on the south, and the house of Joseph shall live in their borders on the north.

paite: Gam mun sagih in va khen unla, huai gelhna hon pia un. Huchi in hiai ah TOUPA i Pathian ma ah ai ka hon sansak ding hi.
english: You shall survey the land into seven parts, and bring the description here to me; and I will cast lots for you here before Yahweh our God.

paite: Levi teng in na lak uah tantuam anei kei ding uh. TOUPA mai a siampu nasep amau goutan ahi. Gad pawl, Reuben pawl leh Manasseh nam kimkhat bel Jordan gal suahlam ah amau tantuam TOUPA sikha Mosi in apiak ana tangta uh," achi hi.
english: However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of Yahweh is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave them.”

paite: Huchi in huai mite apawtkheta ua, Joshua in, "Gam va en vialvial unla, hon gelhkhia unla, ka kiang ah hon tun nawn unla, hiai ah Shiloh ah TOUPA ma ah ai ka hon sansak ding," chi in thu apia hi.
english: The men arose and went. Joshua commanded those who went to survey the land, saying, “Go walk through the land, survey it, and come again to me. I will cast lots for you here before Yahweh in Shiloh.”

paite: Mite akuan ua, gam ava en vialvial ua, mun sagih in akhen ua, laibu ah akhuakhua in agelhkhia ua, giahphual Shiloh ah Joshua kiang ah akik nawn uhi.
english: The men went and passed through the land, and surveyed it by cities into seven portions in a book. They came to Joshua to the camp at Shiloh.

paite: Joshua in Shiloh ah TOUPA ma ah ai ana sansak a; huai ah Joshua in Israel suante akikhendan bang zel un gam ahawmta hi.
english: Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before Yahweh. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.

paite: Aisan a-inkuan uh dungzui in Benjamin suante tung ah aketa a; agamgi chiang uh Judah suante leh Joseph suante kikal ahi.
heading: Benjamin Gam Tan
english: The lot of the tribe of the children of Benjamin came up according to their families. The border of their lot went out between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.

paite: Mallam pang a agamgi chiang uh Jordan a pan ahi a; Jeriko sik ah mallam pang ah apaitou a, tumlam pang ah tanggam ah apaitou zel a; Beth-Aven gamdai ah atawp hi.
english: Their border on the north quarter was from the Jordan. The border went up to the side of Jericho on the north, and went up through the hill country westward. It ended at the wilderness of Beth Aven.

paite: Hiai a pan Luz lam ah, Luz, huai tuh Bethel ahi, sik ah, simlam pang ah apai zel a; Beth-horon khang simlam pang a mual zul ah Ataroth-addar ah apaisuk hi.
english: The border passed along from there to Luz, to the side of Luz (also called Bethel), southward. The border went down to Ataroth Addar, by the mountain that lies on the south of Beth Horon the lower.

paite: Apai zel a, Beth-horon simlam pang a tangchin a pan tumlam ah simlam pang ah akualphei a; Kiriath-baal, huai Kiriath-jearim ahi, Judah suante khopi ah atawp a; huai tumlam pang gamgi ahi.
english: The border extended, and turned around on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon southward; and ended at Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), a city of the children of Judah. This was the west quarter.

paite: Simlam pang a gam Kiriath- jearim tawp a pan ahi a; tumlam ah apawt a, Nephtoah luituite ah apai zel hi.
english: The south quarter was from the farthest part of Kiriath Jearim. The border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.

paite: Rephaim mallam pang phaizang a Hinnom Tapa phaizang chin a tangmong ah apaisuk a; Jebuste sik ah, simlam pang a Hinnom Phaizang ah apaisuk a, En-rogel ah apaisuk hi.
english: The border went down to the farthest part of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of Rephaim northward. It went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En Rogel.

paite: Mallam zuan in apai a, En-shemesh ah apai a, Adummim kahtouhna chin Geliloth ah apai a; Reuben tapa Bohan suang ah apaisuk a;
english: It extended northward, went out at En Shemesh, and went out to Geliloth, which is opposite the ascent of Adummim. It went down to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.

paite: Arabah sik mallam pang ah apai zel a, Arabah ah apaisuk a;
english: It passed along to the side opposite the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.

paite: Beth-hoglah sik, mallam pang ah apai zel a; atawpna bel Jordan simtawp, Chi Tuipi mallam tuipi meng ah ahi. Huai simlam gamgi ahi.
english: The border passed along to the side of Beth Hoglah northward; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the south border.

paite: Jordan suahlam pang, agamgi chiang ahi. Huai ahi Benjamin suante a-inkuan uh dungzui a atantuam gam in akolhkhum sung.
english: The Jordan was its border on the east quarter. This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin, by the borders around it, according to their families.

paite: Benjamin suante a-inkuan dungzui un akhopite uh, Jeriko, Beth- hoglah, Emek-keziz,
english: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,

paite: Beth-arabah, Zemariam, Bethel,
english: Beth Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel,

paite: Avim, Parah, Ophrah,
english: Avvim, Parah, Ophrah,

paite: Kephar-haammonai, Ophni leh Geba; akhopel tengteng toh akhopi tengteng sawm-le-nih ahi.
english: Chephar Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba; twelve cities with their villages.

paite: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,
english: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth,

paite: Mizpeh, Kephirah, Mozah,
english: Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah,

paite: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah;
english: Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah,

paite: Zelah, Eleph, Jebus, huai Jerusalem ahi, Gibeah leh Kiriath, akhotate toh khopi sawm-le-li ahi. Hiaite ahi Benjamin suante a-inkuan uh dungzui ua atantuam ding ua kisepte.
english: Zelah, Eleph, the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem), Gibeath, and Kiriath; fourteen cities with their villages. This is the inheritance of the children of Benjamin according to their families.
